articles.title: Officials Say Passengers and Crew Stopped a Co-Pilot on a FlyDubai Flight
articles.summary: Israeli officials say a FlyDubai co-pilot tried to crash a plane flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The captain opened the cockpit door, and passengers and crew overpowered the attacker. The plane landed safely in Saudi Arabia.

articles.title: Tennessee Stops an Execution and Orders a Review
articles.summary: Tennessee tried to carry out the execution of Christa Pike, but stopped the attempt after two doses of a drug. Governor Bill Lee has ordered a third-party review of how the state carries out the death penalty.

articles.title: U.S. Military to Cut 20% of Its Generals and Admirals
articles.summary: War Secretary Pete Hegseth said the U.S. military will cut 20% of its generals and admirals by Jan. 1, 2027. He also announced a new command for autonomous and robotic systems. Two senators reacted differently.
